decision_basis: Official deep archive (2020-09-01+), tiny storage footprint, perfect 5m grid quality, PIT-safe observation semantics. No cost limitation.

DATA_AUTHORITY.evidence: official data.binance.vision metrics archive; official .CHECKSUM sha256 sidecars verified 21/21

HISTORICAL_DEPTH.evidence: BTCUSDT from 2020-09-01; ETHUSDT/SOLUSDT from 2021-12-01 (independently probed per asset, NOT inferred) through 2026-09-10; 0 missing files; dwarfs the ~30-day REST ceiling

PIT_SAFETY.evidence: observation-time (create_time) semantics; no interpolation; no forward-fill; REST deep-history insufficiency documented (error -1130 on 39-day-old window, empirically verified)

QUALITY.evidence: 6,048 rows = 21 files x 288; exact 5m UTC grid (uniform 300s deltas); 0 duplicates; 0 missing intervals; monotonic after canonical sort; DEF-DATA-OI-001 cadence defect corrected

INFORMATION_DISTINCTNESS.evidence: outstanding position-stock information, categorically distinct from transaction-flow information carried by OHLCV/trade flow (Track J, data-level only)

unit_authority.sum_open_interest: open interest in BASE-ASSET units (e.g. BTC for BTCUSDT) per official binance-public-data README mapping for metrics files
unit_authority.contract_mapping: OpenInterestRecord.open_interest_contracts carries sum_open_interest (base-asset units); OpenInterestRecord.open_interest_value carries sum_open_interest_value (USDT). The two are never conflated; REST field names (sumOpenInterest/sumOpenInterestValue) map to the same semantics.
unit_authority.note: REST_HISTORY_LIMIT (~30d) applies to /futures/data/openInterestHist; the archive is the deep source.

limitations: ETHUSDT/SOLUSDT history starts 2021-12-01 (shorter than trade-flow depth for those assets)
metrics are aggregate/cumulative snapshots at 5m cadence; no per-account or per-price-level breakdown
provider raw files are not row-sorted; canonical sort is part of the deterministic normalizer
rest_history_limit: ~30 days (EMPIRICALLY VERIFIED 2026-09-11: startTime 39 days old rejected with error -1130; recent window works)
